usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing SDN zone's configuration — for example changing exitnodes, MTU, peers list, or IPAM settings. The zone must already exist (use post_cluster_sdn_zones to create it). Changes take effect cluster-wide only after applying the pending SDN configuration via put_cluster_sdn (apply); until then the zone runs on its prior config. Pass the `digest` field (read from get_cluster_sdn_zones_zone) to guard against concurrent edits.

examples.summary: Update an EVPN zone to add a second exitnode and set MTU to 1450

tips: Changes are staged — always call put_cluster_sdn (apply) after this call or your changes will not be active.
Use the `delete` param (comma-separated config key names) to unset optional fields rather than setting them to empty strings.
For VXLAN zones, reducing MTU by at least 50 bytes from the physical NIC MTU avoids fragmentation across the tunnel.
The `digest` field is returned by get_cluster_sdn_zones_zone; supplying it prevents overwriting a concurrent change.
Requires SDN.Allocate on /sdn/zones/{zone} — not the broader Sys.Modify privilege.
